title: Keep the Show linked sites choice when reopening Display Settings
affectedSection: GIS Display Settings: Show linked sites
steps: Open Display Settings for the loaded Surveyor layer.
Select Show linked sites to check or uncheck the setting.
Close Display Settings; the loaded layer remains available.
Reopen Display Settings for the same layer to see your Show linked sites choice retained.
Select Show linked sites again when you want to change the setting back.
screenshotCaptions: Display Settings is reopened for the same selected Surveyor - Service layer, and Show linked sites remains unchecked after the changed setting was closed and reopened.
Display Settings is reopened for the same selected Surveyor - Service layer, and Show linked sites is checked after the setting was changed back and reopened.
reason: Adds instructions for changing Show linked sites and retaining the selected state when Display Settings is closed and reopened for the same loaded Surveyor layer.
